channel.title: LoomSci - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: Latest Artificial Intelligence articles from LoomSci

item.title: Entanglement Unlocks Exponential Capacity Growth in Communications
item.description: Quantum entanglement allows distributed transmitters to coordinate in real time, turning chaotic interference into exponential capacity gains for classical communication networks.

item.title: When AI Safety Withholds the Cure
item.description: When AI safety gates life-saving medical advice, only doctors receive the full answer; patients face withheld knowledge and silent refusal.

item.title: Breaking the Exponential Barrier: Clustering Non-Spherical Gaussians in Polynomial Time
item.description: A polynomial-time sum-of-squares projection separates overlapping non-spherical Gaussian clusters by compressing them into a cleanly separable low-dimensional space.

item.title: How Neural Networks Discover the Irreducible Grammar of Symmetry
item.description: Neural networks trained to multiply group elements spontaneously learn irreducible representations, decomposing symmetry into independent spectral voices.

item.title: Proving Safe Action: AI’s New Logical Straitjacket
item.description: Logical constraints bind an AI agent's actions, forcing every impulse into a provably safe formal proof before execution.

item.title: The Shape of Capability: Why a Spherical Robot Learns to Do Everything
item.description: A spherical robot achieves dynamic isotropy, accelerating equally in any direction, simplifying control and enabling robust locomotion across uneven terrain.

item.title: The Algorithm That Unifies Decision‑Making — From Games to Economics — Under One Mathematical Roof
item.description: Two universal Kan extensions, left and right, unify all decision algorithms from games to economics by extending local knowledge into coherent global behavior.
